asr_text: The message below has two clearly separated sections. And here's the entire text, ready for your attention. So, I just checked the mail and saw something that could be interesting. It's a mysterious letter with no return address, just a vague stamp. I almost threw it out, but I'm glad I didn't. I speak to a camera. Software scores my voice, face, and movements. I read about a woman who did well on a skills test, but AI gave her low scores for her movements and facial expressions. Then the company rejected her. She was without work for a long time. I know about another applicant. This person said AI scored their reliability and honesty. They had no way to say no to the system. They also had no way to challenge the result. I want people to see my skills and character. I do not want them changed into one score.
